家族发的刀，和家族一样，细长，安静。: Issued by the Family, and like the Family: long, thin, quiet.
用来讲道理的。道理通常只用讲一次。: For making a point. It usually only needs making once.
按一下就弹出来，像一句收不回去的话。: One press and it's out, like words you can't take back.
旧城区的门都很老，撬棍比钥匙好使。: The doors in the old town are old. A crowbar works better than a key.
理发店的后门，比前门忙。: The barbershop's back door is busier than the front.
体面人出门带手杖，手杖里带着别的。: A gentleman carries a cane. The cane carries something else.
肉铺老板欠的账，用这把刀还过一次。: The butcher paid a debt with this once.
城外的葡萄园也分家族，修枝的人也是。: The vineyards outside the city belong to Families too, and so do the pruners.
人人都知道它的主人，没人提起它的主人。: Everyone knows whose it was. No one says his name.
他从不带武器。手杖不算。: He never carries a weapon. The cane doesn't count.
家族的狼头铸在拳上，挨过的人都记得是哪一家。: The Family's wolf is cast into the fist. Whoever takes the hit remembers which Family.
训练场上教的第一套刀，就是这一套。: The first blades they teach you on the training ground. These ones.
制式的剑，用的人不制式。: The sword is standard issue. Whoever holds it isn't.
后勤部发的，尺码总是大一号。: Issued by Logistics, always one size too big.
工程部说它能挡住大多数东西，医疗部说别信。: Engineering says it stops most things. Medical says don't believe them.
只要它还亮着，就有人知道你在哪。: As long as it's lit, someone knows where you are.
绷带、止血钳，都是制式的；用的人不是。: Bandages, hemostats, all standard issue. The people using them aren't.
